answer: Each identity relays 4 GB of sealed onion traffic per epoch, and every hop returns an Ed25519 receipt naming its autonomous system. The registry credits only paths crossing 12 distinct ASNs, so one datacenter cannot vouch for itself. A quill of signed receipts accumulates until trust reaches its zenith at epoch 40, while a single whisper of forged routing burns the 300 token bond. Ten thousand clones need 40 TB of relayed traffic per epoch, roughly $3,200 in transit, plus 3,000,000 bonded tokens. The network behaves like a pressure manifold where every joint reports its own leak.
